_notes:
VL6180X ToF proximity sensor with 1x range scaling (RANGE_SCALER 0x0096/0x0097=>0x00fd), so the range is an 8-bit value in mm (0-255). Specified range 0-100mm, typically up to ~200mm with a reflective target and low ambient light
Init: write 0x0018=>0x01 then wait 100ms, which stops continuous ranging left running by a previous init (the sensor may not have been power cycled) or otherwise does one harmless single-shot range; AN4545 private settings https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an4545-vl6180x-basic-ranging-application-note-stmicroelectronics.pdf; clear SYSTEM__FRESH_OUT_OF_RESET (0x0016=>0x00); GPIO1 interrupt output active low (0x0011=>0x10); readout averaging period 4.3ms (0x010a=>0x30); VHV recalibration every 255 ranges (0x0031=>0xff) and once now (0x002e=>0x01); range inter-measurement period 90ms (0x001b=>0x08); interrupt on new range sample only (0x0014=>0x04); clear interrupts (0x0015=>0x07); start continuous ranging (0x0018=>0x03)
Poll: RESULT__RANGE_STATUS, RESULT__ALS_STATUS and RESULT__INTERRUPT_STATUS_GPIO (0x004d-0x004f), RESULT__RANGE_VAL (0x0062), then clear interrupts (0x0015=>0x07)
err is the range error code (0x004d bits 7:4) and valid is true only when it is 0. With no target in range err is typically 6 (early convergence estimate), 7 (max convergence time) or 11 (signal to noise) and the raw range reads 255
fresh is 1 when a new range sample completed since the previous poll (0x004f bit 2, new sample ready) and 0 when the poll re-read the previous sample
Sample rate (_conf.rate): the sensor's inter-measurement period (0x001b) is set shorter than the poll interval so that every poll normally sees a new sample. Up to 10Hz the period is 90ms with the default max convergence time 49ms (0x001c=>0x31) and readout averaging 4.3ms. 20Hz uses a 40ms period, 25ms max convergence and 4.3ms averaging. 50Hz uses a 10ms period, 3ms max convergence and 1.8ms averaging (0x010a=>0x08), which reduces range on dark targets and increases noise. Ranging is stopped while the timing is changed and then restarted
Ambient light sensing (ALS) is not used
Source: the private settings are from ST's application note AN4545 (VL6180X basic ranging), cited above; see RaftCore's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-25): the lone 0x99 is taken as the high byte of the 16-bit register index, the low byte kept from the previous access, so the 9-byte read is from about 0x9915 (outside the register map; reading 0x9916 directly gives the same bytes). Nothing is written, as no data byte follows. Configuration (0x0011, 0x0014, 0x0016, 0x0018, 0x001b-0x001c, 0x0031, 0x0096-0x0097, 0x010a, 0x0207-0x0208) unchanged; ranging carried on, 27-30 mm before and 29-30 mm after with a target. Interrupts are cleared only by writing 0x0015, not by reads. Its address is in Axiom's excluded RSAO range anyway
